help.title: EvPortal help — Shortcuts and Tesla fullscreen
help.description: Organize your EvPortal shortcuts, export or import a backup, and transfer shortcuts from your phone to your Tesla with a QR code.
help.heading: Your screen. Your shortcuts.
help.intro: Tap a shortcut to open the service in a new tab. The theme button at the top switches between light and dark mode. The eight languages are available in Settings with their names and flags; Arabic uses a right-to-left layout.
help.ranking: All shows your most frequently opened shortcuts first. Ties keep your manual order. The ranking is saved after reloading.
help.dragging: In a category or Favorites, tap Edit and move shortcuts using their handles. The star adds a favorite and the pencil lets you edit. Tap Done when finished. All keeps its automatic ranking.
help.keyboard: With a keyboard, focus a handle, press Space, move with the arrow keys, then confirm with Enter. Escape cancels.
help.adding: The + button opens the catalogue and lets you create a shortcut or category. Already added marks a service already on your dashboard. Search looks through all your shortcuts.
help.categories: Create up to five personal categories with names of up to 16 characters and an icon of your choice. Use the pencil to edit them. Existing categories exceeding these limits are kept. All categories remain visible without horizontal scrolling.
help.stepPrepare: In the Tesla, open Settings → Backups → Receive from my phone.
help.stepPublish: Scan the QR code displayed in the Tesla with your phone.
help.stepCode: On your phone, choose its shortcuts or a backup, then send them.
help.stepImport: In the Tesla, review the received shortcuts before using them.
help.stepApply: Confirm on the Tesla. More options in Settings lets you undo the last transfer.
help.qr: The receive QR transfers to the Tesla. A backup QR opens that backup on the phone.
help.snapshot: Direct transfer is encrypted and valid for five minutes when the receiving service is configured. It sends a snapshot, without automatic synchronization. If the service is unavailable, use a Telegra.ph backup.
help.public: Open Settings → Backups → Export a backup, then tap Create my backup. A name is optional. Scan the QR code or copy the link. My backups lets you retrieve a QR code or remove a backup without confirmation. More options also lets you save a JSON file. A Telegra.ph backup is public; its address still exists after its content is removed.
help.fullscreen: While parked, tap Fullscreen. On YouTube, choose Go to site to return to EvPortal in Theater mode. Shortcuts request a new tab; its behavior depends on the vehicle browser.
help.fullscreenFallback: If the Tesla is not recognized, choose Open Tesla Theater in settings. On a computer, the button uses regular fullscreen. The redirect may change with vehicle or YouTube updates.
help.compatibility: Opening a site does not guarantee video playback: country, account, subscription, and browser restrictions may apply. Use entertainment while parked.
help.storage: To restore your shortcuts, open Settings → Backups → Import a backup. Choose a backup from this browser, or open More options to enter a link or code or choose a JSON file. Check the preview before confirming. Your shortcuts and preferences remain stored in this browser; the Tesla browser and Theater may use separate storage.
help.preview: QR codes always open the public EvPortal address. A local preview may differ from what the phone sees. Transfer testing requires a version and service reachable from both devices.
help.privacy: EvPortal is free and is not affiliated with Tesla. Logos and translations are bundled with the site. Opening counts stay in your configuration, with no analytics service. Telegra.ph is contacted at your request; the account token stays separate from the share. Sites you open apply their own policies.
